title: Task reminders
desc: A word about tasks that are due soon or stuck, at the right moment

variables.name: tasks_open
variables.desc: how many tasks can be worked on now

variables.name: first
variables.desc: the task to start with: the weightiest not away

variables.name: item
variables.desc: the task to remind of, if any: the weightiest due soon, or stuck, not resting

variables.name: days
variables.desc: the days to its deadline (none: no deadline)

variables.name: stuck
variables.desc: whether twice its estimate is spent on it

waiting.desc: every minute: what it keeps for the others, and the task to remind of, if any

do.name: open
do.desc: the tasks that can be worked on now

do.name: first
do.desc: the task to start with

do.name: next
do.desc: the task to start with, as it's said

set.name: next_task
set.expr: 'a clean slate: no tasks yet' if first is None else '“' + first.name + '” (about ' + str(first.estimate) + ' min)'

do.name: item
do.desc: the task to remind of: none in a session, nor while a question waits

set.name: item
set.expr: None if session.active or asking else work.tasks[argmax(work.tasks.remind)]

do.name: days
do.desc: the days to its deadline

set.name: days
set.expr: None if item is None or item.deadline is None else (item.deadline - time + daytime) // 1440

do.name: stuck
do.desc: whether it's stuck

set.name: stuck
set.expr: item is not None and item.spent >= 2 * item.estimate

next.desc: put off again and again, or stuck

reminding.desc: the reminder, then at most one this often

do.name: remind
do.desc: asks about it

values.name: item.name
values.due: 'overdue' if days < 0 else 'due today' if days == 0 else 'due tomorrow' if days == 1 else 'due in ' + str(days) + ' days'
values.waits: '' if item.waiting == 0 else ', and 1 task waits on it' if item.waiting == 1 else ', and ' + str(item.waiting) + ' tasks wait on it'
values.ask: 'It\'s done away from the computer: set an alarm, or block time for it?' if item.away else 'Work on it now?'

ask_usr.options: (['I\'ve planned it'] if item.away else ['Start session']) + ['Later', 'Done']
ask_usr.title: Reminder

do.name: start
do.desc: Start session: the task at hand, a session asked for (the task_tracker counts its time)

set.name: work.task
set.expr: item if answer == 0 and not item.away else work.task

do.name: session
do.desc: a session asked for

set.name: session.requested
set.expr: answer == 0 and not item.away or session.requested

do.name: planned
do.desc: planned for: it rests a day

do.name: put_off
do.desc: Later, or no answer: put off once more

do.name: not_put_off
do.desc: else: not put off

do.name: when
do.desc: when it was last reminded of

do.name: done
do.desc: Done: it's done

reconsidering.desc: what's in the way, then a while

do.name: way
do.desc: asks what's in the way

values.says: 'You\'ve spent ' + str(item.spent // 1) + ' min on “' + item.name + '” (about ' + str(item.estimate) + ' min).' if stuck else 'You\'ve put off “' + item.name + '” (about ' + str(item.estimate) + ' min) ' + str(item.put_offs) + ' times, and it\'s ' + ('overdue' if days < 0 else 'due today' if days == 0 else 'due tomorrow' if days == 1 else 'due in ' + str(days) + ' days') + '.'

ask_usr.options: (['It just needs more time'] if stuck else []) + ['It\'s unclear', 'It\'s too big', 'Something else comes first', 'It\'s not worth it anymore']
ask_usr.title: What's in the way?

do.name: more_time
do.desc: it needs more time: the estimate is what's spent, and half of it more

do.name: unclear
do.desc: it's unclear: back to the planner

expr.content: 'Work out what to do first for “' + item.name + '”, in “' + item.group_name + '”: it\'s unclear'

do.name: too_big
do.desc: it's too big: back to the planner, to split

expr.content: 'Split “' + item.name + '”, in “' + item.group_name + '”, into smaller tasks: it\'s more than one sitting'

do.name: rests
do.desc: unclear, too big, or something else first: it rests a day

do.name: not_put_off
do.desc: asked: not put off

do.name: when
do.desc: when it was last reminded of

do.name: dropped
do.desc: not worth it: dropped
